sources.title: K2 Think — Open‑Source Reasoning System (32B)
sources.snippet: K2 Think is a 32B open‑weights reasoning system from MBZUAI & G42. Apache‑2.0 license. Built on Qwen2.5‑32B, tuned with long CoT SFT + RL with verifiable rewards, agentic planning, and test‑time scaling. Up to ~2,000 tok/s on Cerebras WSE. Benchmarks: AIME'24 90.83, AIME'25 81.24, HMMT'25 73.75, OMNI‑MATH‑HARD 60.73, GPQA‑Diamond 71.08, LiveCodeBench v5 63.97.

sources.title: LLM360/K2-Think-V2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: K2-Think: A Parameter-Efficient Reasoning System - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: With the complete K2-Think system, we demonstrate that a 32B-scale model, post-trained to produce long reasoning chains of thought, paired with relatively little test-time computation can endow the small model with capabilities that are competitive with models with orders of magnitude more parameters.

sources.title: K2-Think: A Parameter-Efficient Reasoning System - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Our results validate that a more parameter-efficient model like K2-Think 32B can rival state-of-the-art systems through an integrative post-train recipe including long chain-of-thought training and strategic inference-time enhancements, paving the way for more accessible and affordable open-source reasoning systems.

sources.title: IFM/K2-V2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: K2-V2 is our most capable fully open model to date, and one of the strongest open-weight models in its class. It uses a 70B-parameter dense transformer architecture and represents the latest advancement in the LLM360 model family.
